rules.credential_handling: same-origin cookies on web; bearer-token or authorized fetch adapter on native clients
must: use API-relative paths when same-origin is available
reserve the target aspect ratio before load
retry through the normal auth/session adapter after re-auth
must_not: put bearer tokens in query strings
treat artwork access as public unless the server route says it is public

rules.credential_handling: short-lived secret URL for active media transfer or playback only
must: store in memory only unless a protected offline package manifest explicitly allows local use
redact query parameters in logs and diagnostics
discard on session revoke, expiry, or user switch
must_not: use signed URL strings as cache keys
send signed URLs to platform launcher surfaces

must: use private caches for authenticated artwork
refresh platform-owned surfaces when ETag or artwork revision changes
clear cached entries after library access is revoked
must_not: append bearer tokens or signatures for cache busting
reuse stale launcher artwork after access revalidation fails

must: keep fallback artwork visually quieter than real artwork
must_not: render raw filenames as placeholder text
hide important unavailable states with only a decorative image

source_priority: cached authenticated artwork if policy permits
must: use the package manifest revision to invalidate local artwork
serve local artwork only from protected app storage
must_not: fall back to expired remote signed URLs
expose protected artwork through public filesystem paths

must: show a specific state badge when media access or playback is blocked
must_not: silently downgrade revoked media into a generic missing image state
